timeline.summary: On April 24, 2026, statutory auditor Nikhil Warankar & Co. resigned due to peer-review eligibility requirements.
EFC (I) incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary, EFC Estate Wakadewadi 2 Private Limited, on April 29, 2026 with a capital of ₹1,000.
On May 1, 2026, EFC (I) approved the terms of a ₹160 Cr rights issue at ₹150 per share with an 8:103 ratio.
EFC (I) fixed May 7, 2026 as the record date for its rights issue.
On May 7, 2026, EFC (I) incorporated two wholly-owned subsidiaries, EFC Estate Marisoft 3 and Marisoft 4.
On May 15, 2026, EFC (I) Limited released the Monitoring Agency Report from CARE Ratings for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
On May 25, 2026, EFC (I) approved the allotment of 1,06,62,786 equity shares at ₹150 each, raising ₹159.94 Cr via its rights issue.
EFC (I) Limited rescheduled Q4 earnings conference call to **8:30 AM IST** on **May 29, 2026**, per **Kumar AmanDate & Kumar Gupta**’s notice.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹292.88 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹69.4 Cr.
EFC (I) Limited’s Aman Gupta notified BSE and NSE of the Q4 FY2025-26 earnings conference call audio recording, available on May 29, 2026, via the company’s website.
On June 3, 2026, EFC (I) Limited filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 29, 2026.
On October 27, 2026, EFC (I) Limited informed that the NCLT fixed November 27, 2026 for the final hearing of the demerger petition.
EFC (I) Limited will host an earnings conference call on Tuesday, 3 November 2026 at 11:00 AM IST.
